cohort: 320 mothers who delivered at Arba Minch town governmental health facilities in South Ethiopia between April 1 and June 30, 2022.
finding: Maternal satisfaction with delivery service was 75%, and it was associated with residence, anemia during pregnancy, antepartum hemorrhage, induction to onset of labor, sex of the newborn, fetal distress during labor, intrauterine meconium release, and privacy measures during examination.
